data.name: Ilian
data.long_meaning: Ilian is a Greek name derived from the Greek god Helios, meaning 'sun'. In Christianity, it is also associated with St. Helian, a 1st-century Roman soldier who was martyred for his faith.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the light and warmth of the sun, which can be seen as a symbol of God's love and grace.

in_hebrew.name: איליאן
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא אור ה' איליאן הוא משמעות השם
in_hebrew.long_meaning: איליאן הוא שם שמקורו בשפה היוונית ונמצא בשימוש במסורות נוצריות. משמעותו 'אלוהים הוא אור ה'' או 'אור האל', והוא קשור לשם היווני 'אליהו' שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא ה''

in_greek.name: Ηλίας
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι το φως μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ηλίας ή Ιλίας, είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού שם אליהו (אליהו), που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ο Κύριός μου' ή 'Ο Θεός είναι το φως μου'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας Ορθόδοξης, το όνομα συνδέεται με τον προφήτη Ηλία, έναν από τους σημαντικότερους προφήτες της Παλαιάς Διαθήκης

in_latin.name: Ilian
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ilian, derivatum ex Graeco 'Ηλίας', significat 'Deus est lux mea' vel 'Deus est Dominus meus'. Nomen hoc in traditione Christiana, praesertim in Ecclesia Orthodoxa, saepe associatur cum propheta Elia, qui in Veteri Testamento commemoratur

in_english.name: Ilian
in_english.meaning: God is my light or God is my Lord
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ilian is derived from the Greek form of the Hebrew name 'Eliyahu' (אליהו), meaning 'God is my light' or 'God is my Lord'. It is associated with the prophet Elijah, a significant figure in the Old Testament. In Christian tradition, particularly in Orthodox Church, the name Ilian symbolizes spiritual enlightenment and devotion to God. It signifies a person of strong faith and inner light

biblical_reference.note: The name is associated with the prophet Elijah, who lived in the 9th century BCE and was a significant figure in the history of the Israelites

data.cultural_impact: Ilian is a name rooted in Greek mythology, evoking the golden sun and the vibrant, fiery energy it represents. It has a rich cultural history, inspiring art, literature, and even architectural designs throughout history. It is also a name that carries a sense of strength, resilience, and vitality, which is highly valued in many cultures. In modern Western cultures, the name is often used as a variant of the more common English name "Hellan" or "Helen", and it continues to be a popular choice among parents looking for unique and meaningful names for their children.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Ilian is deeply associated with St. Helian, a 1st-century Roman soldier who is often depicted as the father of St. Felicita, the first-known martyr of the Christian faith in ancient Rome. Legends tell of his bold faith in the face of persecution, even going so far as to rescue other Christians from their executioners. He was eventually discovered and put to death for his beliefs, and his story of courage and devotion to God continues to inspire and resonate with people today. The name Ilian thus carries a spiritual significance of deep faith, courage, and a commitment to living one's beliefs, even in the face of adversity.

historical_references.reference: According to Greek mythology, Ilian was the son of King Priam of Troy and Hecuba. He was renowned for his great beauty and was the object of jealousy for Paris, who abducted Helen, the wife of Menelaus, King of Sparta. The Trojan War ensued, which lasted for ten years and ended with the fall of Troy. Ilian, known as Hector in the Iliad, was the greatest Trojan warrior and was the adversary of Achilles. He was eventually killed by Achilles during the war, and his funeral was a major focus of the Iliad.

St. Ilian was a 4th-century Roman soldier and martyr. According to legend, he was a soldier in the Roman army under the Emperor Diocletian and was ordered to offer sacrifice to the Roman gods. He refused and was cast into a pit filled with venomous serpents. The serpents did not harm him, and a tree grew up from the ground to shelter him. He was later beheaded for his refusal to renounce Christ. Ilian is the patron saint of soldiers, the military, and captives.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Ilian remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: James Ilian, a minister in Dublin, Ireland, shares that their name Ilian meaning "Sun god" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Ilian is a name of ancient Illyrian origin, symbolizing the radiant light of hope and courage in the face of adversity. It reflects the Christian belief in the power of the Divine Light to overcome darkness and challenges in life.
